svg.title: Allocator: RSS at three measured states
svg.desc: Same million-key workload. Bars = medians of 3 rounds; small dots = raw round states (5-read state medians). RSS snapshots are not VmHWM or allocated bytes. Retained RSS is not proof of a leak; VmSize is tabulated separately.
